entities.name: Caliphear
entities.description: A nightmare steed who lives in the Great Salt Marshes of Western Golthonor and is summoned by Jamil; she allies with Altair.

entities.name: Altair of Coloni
entities.description: A human wanderer, secretly a mighty planeswalker protected by an enchantment, who allies with Caliphear and offers ten years of service.

entities.name: Nevar
entities.description: A wizard who battles his brother Jamil and falls to Caliphear.

entities.name: Jamil
entities.description: A wizard who summons Caliphear to defeat his brother Nevar.

entities.name: Coldraith
entities.description: A wizard who halted the Golthonor Torrent to hoard water and blue mana; killed by Caliphear.

entities.name: Samite Healer
entities.description: A healer who leads an army besieging Coldraith's keep.

entities.name: Devouring Deep
entities.description: A captured soldier of Coldraith's army, whose darkest fear Caliphear reveals.

entities.name: Ravidel
entities.description: Party whose river invasion was cut off by Coldraith's halting of the Torrent.

entities.name: Golthonor
entities.description: Region of Dominaria where the Great Salt Marshes lie.

entities.name: Great Salt Marshes
entities.description: Caliphear's home swamp, being drained by Coldraith's enchantment.

entities.name: Golthonor Torrent
entities.description: River meant to feed the Salt Marshes, blocked by Coldraith.

entities.name: Corthipan Inlet
entities.description: Place where the Torrent should feed the marshes and Caliphear finds it blocked.

entities.name: Plains of Coloni
entities.description: Altair's home, flooded by the same water.

entities.name: Coldraith's Keep
entities.description: Coldraith's fortress, surrounded by a Wall of Brambles.

entities.name: Stonehaven
entities.description: Region in chaos that Coldraith exploits.

events.summary: Jamil summons Caliphear and she kills his brother Nevar; she is then unsummoned and returns home to Golthonor.
events.quote: the wizard Nevar quickly falls before the might of the dark steed.

events.summary: Caliphear finds her swamp dying and defeats an Azure Drake chasing Laconia; Laconia explains the raid and the draining enchantment.
events.quote: Since she is on her own ground, Caliphear easily defeats the Drake.

events.summary: At the Corthipan Inlet Caliphear finds the Torrent blocked and meets Altair, whose enchantment redirects her magic; they ally for ten years of his service.
events.quote: In exchange for her help, Altair offers her ten years of service. Caliphear accepts.

events.summary: Caliphear tortures a captive Devouring Deep until Altair stops her; it reveals it serves Coldraith.
events.quote: The Devouring Deep confesses to serve the wizard Coldraith of Golthonor .

events.summary: At Coldraith's Keep Caliphear catapults Altair over the wall; Altair destroys the Wall of Brambles with Swords to Plowshares and the Healer's army fights the Brass Men.
events.quote: In order to get over the wall, Caliphear catapults Altair over the wall.

events.summary: Coldraith casts Tranquility, freeing Altair from his bindings and revealing him as a mighty Planeswalker; Caliphear kills the vulnerable Coldraith.
events.quote: he is revealed to be a mighty Planeswalker.

events.summary: With Coldraith dead his spells break and the Torrent flows again; Altair confirms he will serve Caliphear for ten years.
events.quote: Altair remembers his promise and confirms his intention to be her servant for ten years.

relations.quote: two brothers wizards, Nevar and Jamil
